releaseSummary: Salary figures, tax estimates and HR notes now start blurred on the payroll run, income tax and employee pages and on /me. **Show figures** reveals them for 30 seconds; they blur again on their own, or straight away on **Hide**, on leaving the page, or on switching browser tab.

moduleImpact.notes: Updated as part of HR privacy filter.

migrationNotes: No manual data migration is required for this release.
